_comment: Permission posture. Principle: allow anything that produces evidence or is revertible, ask for anything that changes shared configuration or rewrites history, deny secrets, generated output, and irreversible git. git commit is allowed because git push is denied - the work stays local, and a commit per verified increment is the point of the loop, so prompting for each one just trains you to approve without reading. merge and rebase rewrite history and still ask.
